purpose: Teach: あめ/サヨナラ/ミーハー/ひとみ/られよ/スキップ/バツ/下敷き

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、あめ玉ばっか舐めてたな
lines.en: You were basically just sucking on hard candy all day, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing, familiar tone. Quick jab delivered without malice. Eye contact, slight smirk. Rhythm fast and pointed — she's got ammunition and she knows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女にサヨナラ言えなかったろ、桜
lines.en: And you couldn't even say goodbye to your girlfriend, Sakura.
lines.style: Defensive but deflecting with humor. Lower register, quicker snap-back. Not actually hurt — playing the game, turning it back on her. Light challenge in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ミーハーすぎだぞ
lines.en: You're way too into trends, Riku. Seriously.
lines.style: Exasperated laugh underneath. Shaking her head slightly. Mock-serious tone but affectionate — this is familiar territory between them. Pace slows just enough to land the dig.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のひとみがキラキラしてたな、桜
lines.en: Your eyes were absolutely sparkling back there, Sakura.
lines.style: Gentle observation disguised as teasing. Softer attack than his last line. Noticing something real about her, disguising it in their back-and-forth. Slightly shy beneath the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先輩から「気を付けられよ」と注意されたな
lines.en: A senior actually warned you to be careful, didn't they, Riku?
lines.style: More serious now, but still playful. Slight pause before the line — this one landed. Not mean-spirited, genuinely curious. A note of actual concern underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後スキップしてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were skipping classes after school, Sakura.
lines.style: Caught-you moment. Slower pace, slight weight on the accusation. But there's no real anger — he's impressed and trying not to show it. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストでバツが多かったな
lines.en: You got way more wrong answers than right on that test, Riku.
lines.style: Final jab before the end. Rhythmic, confident. She's enjoying this — the rapid-fire back-and-forth, having the last word. Slight laugh at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノートに下敷きしてないから字が薄いな、桜
lines.en: Your handwriting's so faint in your notebook because you never use a desk pad, Sakura.
lines.style: Specific, observant comeback delivered close and low. Intimate because he's noticed tiny details. Warm underneath the wryness — this is how he shows he's been paying attention.
